newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says exploration well shows gas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says exploration well shows gas.

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Friday an exploration well in the Cooper/Eromanga Basins had flowed gas.

The well, Judga North-1, flowed gas at 227,000 cubic metres per day (8.02 million cubic feet per day) with 34 kilolitres (216 barrels) of 59.1 deg API condensate per day from resevoir sands in the Permian Patchawarra Formation, Santos said.
Judga North-1 is located 25 kilometres east of the Ballera gas centre.
The well will be cased and suspended as a future gas producer, Santos said.
Santos holds a 58.8625 percent stake in the southwest Queensland unit, which includes Judga North-1.
Delhi Petroleum holds 23.2000 percent, Boral Ltd 16.5000 percent, Australian Hydrocarbons Ltd 1.2000 percent and Oil Co of Australia Ltd 0.2375 percent.
